value.title: Complete Movie
value.synopsis: In their quest for One Piece, the Straw Hat crew arrives in Grantesoro, the entertainment capital of the world, where wealthy men come to gamble in the casino and watch the grandest shows. Grantesoro is an impregnable sanctuary controlled by the Emperor of Gold, Gild Tesoro. Even the Navy cannot intervene there. But Luffy and his companions will quickly discover the frightening hidden side of this city and will have to risk their lives to try to escape.
